I'll review the merge diff on `fix/gameplay-effects-review-1031` against master, read-only, and check each of the seven points against the code and tests.The branch is `ea7eff1` with five commits. Next I’ll read the source diffs for save preservation, card effects, flight, celebration, tests, and the browser harness.The save and flight call sites are the risky part. I’ll read those handlers and the new harness paths before judging whether a test would still pass if the fix were reverted.VERDICT: APPROVE

BLOCKERS: none

SHOULD-FIX:
- `reviews/review-2026-10-31.md:5` — the report says the current Lua suite is 278 tests. `lua solver/tests/run_all.lua` on `ea7eff1` printed `Total: 279 passed / 0 failed`. The later note at line 184 says 279. A reader of the opening will reject a 279 run as the wrong tree.
- `INDEX.md:77` — says a release `boot` fails with "engine never announced itself" and that a release boot scenario should not be added. `tools/browser-test.py:352-353` skips that expect when `is_release` is set, and `boot` is in `RELEASE_SCENARIOS` (`tools/browser-test.py:2320-2321`). `browser-review.py --release` therefore runs `boot` and passes it once `Module._isEngineLoaded` is true, with no log assertion.

NITS:
- `main/Scripts/cursor.script:337` sets dragon z to `0.5 + delay * 0.01` before the movement delay, so queued dragons jump to the flight layer while still on their columns.
- `INDEX.md:77` and `tools/browser-test.py:966-969` still say PLAY is always driven by the mouse. With `--mobile`, `click_game` sends CDP touch (`tools/browser-test.py:295-305`). The extra synthetic `touchend` check is still there.
- `faulthandler.dump_traceback_later(30)` in `close_browser` (`tools/browser-test.py:2332`) only prints a stack. `browser.close()` has no timeout, and `report.json` is written after `close` returns (`tools/browser-test.py:2431-2435`), so a hung close delays the report until the 900s batch timeout.
- `main/Scripts/card.script:270-271` sets `is_highlighted` and then returns while a drag is active, so a hint that arrives mid-drag is not applied after the drop. The review already says this guard was not mutation-tested.
- `plans/handoff-0925.md:160` still says the reproduce command expects `273/0`. On this branch the same command prints 279.

UNVERIFIED:
- The `[ANIMQ]` notes in `architecture.md:264-270` show that a composite `position` animation cancels `position.x`. They do not show whether a second `position.y` animation cancels a live `position.x`. `fly_card_arc` (`cursor.script:338-344`) depends on those two tracks running together. The y callback still posts `drop_success`, and the slot then snaps the card, so a cancelled x track would be a visual kink rather than a stuck card or a `flying_count` leak. Not measured here.
- Debug Space does `msg.post("#", "restart_level")` with no table (`game_manager.script:121`). `on_message` then reads `message.preserve_save` (`game_manager.script:90`). This is safe if Defold supplies `{}`. That runtime was not executed here.
- The 34-scenario browser matrix in the review was not re-run.

Save, effects, flight, celebration, and the new tests, by inspection: TUTORIAL, SKIP, and PLAY NOW call `restart_level(true)` (`gui/ui.gui_script:114`, `:135`, `:184`). Rail RESTART and PLAY AGAIN call `restart_level()` (`:170`, `:142`). `game_manager` clears only when `preserve_save` is absent (`game_manager.script:90`). Tutorial init deals the lesson before `load_saved_game` (`main.script:55-72`), `should_save` refuses tutorial boards (`main.script:1262`), and a tutorial win does not clear the file because `is_full_deal` is false (`main.script:111`, `:2497-2499`). `drop_success` and `drop_failed` both fade `#shadow` and animate scale back to 1 (`card.script:173-203`, `:209-212`). The unhighlight guard returns while `is_dragging` (`card.script:279-280`). Flower occupy only snaps (`flower_slot.script:22`). Foundation z is captured after `card_count` increments (`base_slot.script:25-40`). Confetti uses no `math.random`, replaces a live burst in `start`, and deletes nodes on expiry, hide, and `final` (`celebration.lua:9-34`, `gui/ui.gui_script:191`, `:227`, `:256-257`). Each new test asserts the post-fix behavior, so reverting that line fails the assert. The celebration test drives real `celebration.lua` plus `ui` `final`; the GUI object is mocked, the cleanup is not.

COMMANDS RUN:
- `git rev-parse` / `git log master...HEAD` / `git diff --stat master...HEAD` — pass, HEAD `ea7eff1`, five commits, 26 files
- `git diff master...HEAD` on the gameplay, test, and harness files — pass (read)
- `lua solver/tests/run_all.lua` — pass, 279/0
- `git diff --check master...HEAD` — pass, exit 0
note: Existing completed review verified on 2026-11-02; no second Grok review was launched. Reasoning and private session transcripts are not included.
